message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors.

Issues:

- Missing Mockito imports; we can remove Mockito usage because not needed for tests. Use no mocking; we can just instantiate ValidationContext directly via factory. So remove @Mock annotations and related imports.

- Also factory.getValidationContext() method does not exist. Need to obtain ValidationContext from factory differently. In JsonSchemaFactory, there is method getValidationContext? Actually maybe there is method getValidationContext() but not; compile error says not. We can get ValidationContext via factory.getMetaSchema().getValidationContext()? Not sure. But we can simply use the ValidationContext from the factory's internal field? Maybe JsonSchemaFactory has method getValidationContext()? Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator library, JsonSchemaFactory has method getValidationContext() returning ValidationContext. I think there is method getValidationContext(). But compile error says not. Maybe version used doesn't have that method; instead you get ValidationContext via factory.getMetaSchema().getValidationContext()? Actually JsonMetaSchema holds ValidationContext? Not.

Alternative: Instead of using factory, we can directly create a ValidationContext via new ValidationContext(...). But we need constructor signature. Not sure.

Simplify: Since tests only need a ValidationContext instance, we could use null and adjust test expectations accordingly? The tests expect same instance. We could just create a dummy ValidationContext implementation (maybe interface) but it's a class. Let's inspect: ValidationContext is likely a class with default constructor. Probably has default no-arg constructor. So we can instantiate new ValidationContext().

Thus modify setup: validationContext = new ValidationContext(); Remove factory usage.

Also remove imports for Mockito and JUnit extensions not needed.

Also remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation.

Also remove unused imports: org.junit.jupiter.params.*, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.*, org.mockito.*, org.junit.jupiter.api.*, org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach duplicate.

Simplify imports: import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode; import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test; import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest; import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource; import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;

Now adjust code accordingly.

Also need to handle checked exception from mapper.readTree; need to add throws Exception to setup method or test methods. In current code, setupBeforeEach calls mapper.readTree which throws IOException. So need to declare throws Exception.

Add throws Exception to setupBeforeEach.

Similarly other test methods that call mapper.readTree need throws Exception. Add throws Exception to those test methods.

Now code.
